# Blind Pew 0.2.0

This release adds offline Arabic phonetic input on QWERTY and QWERTZ. Choose
**Arabic — Transliteration** in settings, or select `ar` in the CLI. Try
`slam` → سلام or `mr.7ba` → مرحبا. The profile includes explicit shortcuts
for hamza and diacritics, and preserves ordinary numbers.

The application uses the system keyboard icon. F12 restores the earlier IBus
input method when switching transliteration off. Blind Pew preserves edited
shortcuts and shows errors if it cannot activate a source. The CLI handles
early pipe closure without printing a traceback.

## Install or upgrade

Download the DEB and its checksum file. Verify the checksum before installing.

~~~sh
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS && sudo apt install ./blind-pew_0.2.0-1_all.deb
~~~

After installation, sign out and back in so IBus can refresh its engines.
See the [README](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/blob/v0.2.0-1/README.md)
for setup and the [testing notes](https://github.com/gagafes/blind-pew/blob/v0.2.0-1/docs/TESTING.md)
for coverage.
